attachments.origin_landmark: lesser wing of the sphenoid, above the optic canal
attachments.insertion_landmark: skin and tarsal plate of the upper eyelid

innervation.root_levels: CN III (with sympathetic supply to the superior tarsal muscle)

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Dual supply is what makes ptosis diagnostic: CN III palsy gives complete ptosis, whereas loss of the sympathetic supply to the smooth superior tarsal (Muller's) muscle within it gives the partial ptosis of Horner syndrome.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
